newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian boat, Panama ship collide north of Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Italian boat, Panama ship collide north of Tunisia.

text.p: An Italian fishing boat collided with a Panamanian tanker in international waters north of Tunisia on Saturday, Italian coastguards said.
They named the Italian boat as "Beppe Cardella" and the Panamanian ship as "Sea Wind".
The Italian craft was reported to have suffered structural damage in the collision, which happened late on Friday, but coastguards said there were no injuries.

Lloyds Casualty Reporting Service said the Sea Wind did not stop after the collision and proceeded in a north-westerly direction. Italian coastguards said an investigation was being carried out into the incident.
